text:
nina: Quick heads up 1: HarborTrust kickoff in 11am. They want a 48h POC to validate migration from CompetitorQ. Scope: compat shim for inline tool calls, 200-prompt parity diff, short reserved vs hosted pricing, and security questionnaire (SAML, BYO-KMS, VPC peering). cc @leo @ana @mike
leo: I can prototype a shim. CompetitorQ emits inline markers like <<CALL:export user>>. Plan: prefix-detect + map to structured tool calls. Prototype by EOD.
nana: Product asks for a deterministic run (temp=0 + strict stops) and a default-sampling run to show delta. We'll include p50/p99 latency numbers too.
mike: Security: they require BYO-KMS, SAML/SCIM, audit logs >=90d, and contractual data residency. Legal will need to review KMS language.
finance-bot: Quick slide numbers: hosted gen $0.0165/1k tokens, embeddings $0.0037/1k. Rough 2-week dedicated trial (pro-rated) ~$8k for a 2-node reserve; I'll confirm PO.
leo: Adapter sketch for the POC deck: ```regex
^<<CALL:(\\w+)(?:\s+([^>]+))?>>
Mapping -> {"tool":"$1","args":parse($2)}
``` We'll also canonicalize stop tokens and trim streaming chunks before diff.
nina: HarborTrust also asked about billing granularity (per-token vs per-request) and a sample invoice. Finance please attach both options to the deck.
ana: Tests: include 30 tool-heavy prompts and 20 streaming-edge cases (CompetitorQ tends to chunk). I'll prepare the 200 prompt set from our corpus.
mike: Ops note: we can provision VPC peering once we have CIDR ranges and billing code. Typical turnaround 24h after info.
ops: Ack, ping us with IPs.
leo: Early local run (first 40 prompts): default sampling -> ~10.8% token-level divergence; deterministic -> ~2.7%. Most diffs from stop-seq handling and trailing punctuation. Tool normalization removed ~60% of false-positive tool detections.
nina: Owners: shim=leo, diff+reports=ana, pricing=finance-bot, security/legal=mike, infra=ops. I'll coordinate customer comms.
sec-bot: Security questionnaire created: https://redwood.example.com/secforms/harbortrust-1918
finance-bot: I'll attach per-token and per-request examples and the pro-forma PO by EOD.
nina: Please keep adapter toggleable (don't change production behaviour). Include one before/after mapping example in the POC deliverables. Reconvene after ana uploads full diff. :thumbsup:
